name: resonance_cv_extremes
rationale: A 2 V constant audio input with drive 0 gives normalized input 0.4, allowing feedback to affect the filter rather than permanently saturating its input. The fixture remains classified as driven even if full resonance adds an autonomous component: every sample, including startup and all 257-frame boundaries, retains the original pointwise acceptance with no alignment, discard, tolerance relaxation or reclassification. Five audio lanes exercise two rounded groups and mono CV broadcast.

counterfactual_predeclaration.sensitivity: Each of the four sign combinations runs from newly constructed DSP with identical post-constructor SDK/Rust RNG seed and input. Each connected output must differ from the fresh zero-depth baseline by more than 0.001 V in at least one sample; SDK and Rust are also compared with the original driven tolerance.
counterfactual_predeclaration.zero_depth_rejection: Two separate fresh traces with depth zero and CV +1000000/-1000000 must be exactly equal to the fresh zero-CV, zero-depth baseline in every f32 output sample and initial/final RNG state, independently in SDK and Rust. No mixed-segment retained history is used for this proof.
